notes.title: V.0.235 Kickstarter Announcement (and LTE update)
notes.content:
Panda has been busy at work launching our new game Kitty Catsanova (currently beta testing on Kongregate but will be on Steam soon) and preparing a new girl in Crush Crush, as well as other cool stuff we aren’t ready to share just yet ;)

First thing - we’re really excited to announce that starting tomorrow (May 1) we will be launching a Kickstarter for a new dating game! It will feature several of our Crush Crush girls in a new setting / storyline. 

It’s not so much a sequel as it’s a re-imagining. This visual novel will play a lot like Long Live the Queen, and explore darker and more mature themes - which we’re stoked about - while keeping up the same comedy/flirty tone you’d find in Crush Crush.

Onto Crush Crush! In today’s update we’ve made some changes to the LTE (limited time events) system (which frankly are a bit overdue). Back when Crush Crush was our only focus, these would have reached you guys much sooner, so we’re super sorry we tested your patience with them! 

Here is a quick run-down on the latest changes:
[list]
[*] Event tokens now don’t have timers! They’re instantly rewarded (but you still have to click ‘Claim!’).
[*] Players will now have to earn every token for an event, but the cost for those tokens has gone down as well. A missed token won’t have as much of a heavy penalty.
[*] One of the Daily Tasks will always be a Diamond Reward (or sometimes a Time Block reward), but we will be increasing the time they take and Time Block consumption. Now players have access to a daily diamond grinder. This difficulty increase is partially to offset the much easier LTE rewards. (Let us know how these changes feel!)  
[*] Diamond costs for insta-finishing Tasks has been substantially lowered as well.
[*] The next few rewards are for bikinis and then we’ll be bringing back last year’s “Summer Fling” Pin-up.
[/list]

Hopefully that helps address some of the issues people had with the LTE. We’d love to hear what you think, and will do our best to read all of the Steam comments and Forum threads. It’s just a crazy busy time for us right now so we can’t guarantee we’ll be able to respond to many of them v.v

Thanks everyone!
~Sad Pandas

Update: The kickstarter is LIVE here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sadpandastudios/hush-hush-only-your-love-can-save-them

notes.title: V.0.166 NSFW dlc is out!
notes.content:
Greetings sugar cookies, OjiPanda here. 

Let’s chat about the Nude DLC. 

Wowzers this took a while, hey? Today I’m here to chat about what the Nude DLC is, how it works, why it works the way it do, and what the future holds for Crush Crush, Sad Panda, and the fate of the universe. Here’s what’s going down:

Sad Panda is going to start offering paid Nude DLC expansions to our games. We’re going to be offering this DLC on our own website: [url=https://sadpandastudios.com] HERE [/url]

I imagine you have some questions, and here’s what I imagine they sound like:

[h1] [Why are you doing this on your own website?] [/h1]

For the last… bunch of months, we’ve been chatting with a few platforms on guidelines for adult content. Unfortunately, this has been a frustrating process. Some platforms don’t want to set guidelines, and others are simply against the inclusion of such content. There’s a very strong “try and see” mentality in the industry, which has unfortunately cost some developers dearly when the hammer does fall.

So we decided that, if we’re going to be able to offer our fans what they want regardless of platform, we would need a platform-agnostic solution. So we got to work on a system that, once the DLC is purchased, adds the NSFW content as an ‘Uncensored Mode’ toggle in-game. 

[h1] [Why does the DLC cost money, you greedy sons of bitches?] [/h1]

There are a few reasons. But I know that whenever game developers ask for money, (especially in F2P games) it can cause a lot of mixed feelings. I get it. I’m right there with you. Game devs can sometimes get shady or grabby with this kind of stuff, so I’mma try to keep it above board with you guys.

The first is - we want to have a purchase between the DLC and the user so we can have some control over who has it. In effect, we want to have an age restriction step to authenticating it. Why? It’s all about due diligence and image. We don’t want to make the DLC easily available to kids. We’re all about creating sexy adult content for adults. 

Now, as the nude version of the game will remain available on Nutaku for free, this may seem a bit suspect. We are leaning on Nutaku’s own age gating for their site, which is not as difficult to overcome as providing a credit card transaction, but we’re okay with this arrangement. Again - due dilligence and image. 

The next reason is - we feel that the sexy content is worth paying for. We’ve priced the DLC a bit higher than an average purchase in Crush Crush ($7), and have included a bunch of stuff to make it a worthwhile purchase ($5 of diamonds and all the “sexy” outfits for free). 

One huge advantage to the Steam version is we can offer high-res sexy artwork. It’ll be the shiniest version available for sure. Future voiced audio will also have the ‘nsfw’ bonus audio included in this mode. Audio files can be pretty large for a web game so we’re only going to be adding this feature to the Steam version.

[h1] [I checked out the site. What’s the “Panda Pass” option?] [/h1]

Going forward, we’re going to be launching more games in the Crush Crush universe, and offering similar adult DLC for each one. 

The Panda Pass DLC is an option to unlock all the future NSFW DLC, for all Sad Panda games. 

It might go up in price over time. Who knows? BEST DEAL! BUY TODAY!

[h1] [Can I trust this transaction? You’re not using some dodgy credit card software, are you?] [/h1]

We’re actually using some code / backend support from none other than the Humble Bundle guys. They have a great system that anyone can jump on, so we decided to run with that. 

[h1] [So what do I gotta do? And what do I get?] [/h1]

The NSFW DLC adds a ‘Uncensored Mode’ toggle to Crush Crush on Steam. It adds hi-res sexy scenes and pinups, and includes free "lingerie" and "birthday suit" outfits and 55 diamonds.

Here’s how you get it! [url=https://www.sadpandastudios.com/nsfw_faq.html]
 FAQ [/url]

[h1] [Are you guys going to keep updating Crush Crush? You’ve talked about other features in the past…] [/h1]

We are. We’ve had our hands full the last half year, but we’ve got some cool stuff we still want to add. At some point, we’re going to work on a VN and spin-offs, because we’ve stretched the Crush Crush experience to its limit, but we definitely have a backlog of features we’d like to see added before we consider Crush Crush complete. 

Okay, I think that covers everything. If you have questions (or if you want to bitch out OjiPanda, because he’s a filthy sellout) then please post below. 

Love you guys, more soon. 
[b] ------------------------------ [/b]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
   [*] If you haven't noticed the new icon in the top right, we've added in a notifications area where you can read information about the latest news from Sad Panda Studios!  This includes patch notes, announcements on new events, and is a place where we can let you know about things we are working on.  It's pretty basic for now, but we're going to evolve it to include other content (such as images, etc) in the future!
   [*] Your memory album should now persist across prestige.  This means you can still check out all of the images you earned from your previous games.
   [*] Automatic cloud save to help with recovering lost save files (due to a reformat, etc).
   [*]  Reduced the size of the installed game by about 16MB (almost 10%).
   [*] A little sound byte plays when the game first starts, which was a request from Artist Panda.
   [*] A checkbox now appears on completed hobbies (hobbies that have hit level 75).  We also moved the play/pause/checkbox icon a little bit to show up in the middle of the progress bar.
   [*] The progress text on hobbies now disappears when the hobby hits maximum level.
 [*] The new website is now live, and includes integration for the Humble Widget for purchasing the NSFW DLC.  We just did some test purchases, and it works well so far.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Masked UI elements that should be off-screen at non-standard resolutions.
   [*] Fixed sorting for some popups so that they appear over particles.

notes.title: V.0.111
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've been hard at work on this update because it's pretty unique. There's a bunch of cool stuff we did differently this time, so here are the update notes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] TWO new girls added, with crazy different requirements.
    [*] Final cutscenes.
    [*] Music changes (for dramatic impact!)
    [*] End Credits
    [*] Updated the Stats page to have icons represented with the stats (easier to identify requirements this way)

    [*] New settings to skip girl introductions and affection popups (check the Settings dialog on the More page)
    [*] New achievements for the different Outro choices and for reset boosts
    [*] DXT5 image compression butchers some of the art, so we're moving some of that back to Truecolor (32-bit).  This will increase game size a bit, but will make the art much nicer in some cases.

[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed achievement icon issues.
    [*] Fixed typos.
    [*] Improved asset bundles and loading intros.
    [*] Added in some text that was missing.

    [*] Re-wrote the way in which hobby progression is computed, which will fix many issues people had with online progress calculation.  You should now find the hobby progress will work correctly even when your reset boost/purchased boost are low, and even when online.
    [*] Fixed a couple of places that null reference exceptions could occur.
    [*] Reset the number of assets that need to be loaded/have loaded so that you don't get ever increasing numbers on the loading screen.
    [*] Resized a couple of images to take better advantage of image compression.

Also, in other fun news we finalized our cast for the lovely ladies who will be voicing our characters. Recording is already underway; so we'll be posting info on our cast next week (@crushcrushDX).

Then we're off to GDC to soak up lots of knowledge, meet other developers, and try to hunt down a publisher for getting Crush Crush on mobile! Wish us good luck.

~Sad Pandas

notes.title: Crush Crush plans for 2017!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Artist Panda here (Morgo) :3

I just wanted to say HAPPY NEW YEAR to everyone and give you the quick run-down of what we're planning for Crush Crush:
[list]
    [*] Holiday sale takedown (just now) ...it was really awesome to see how many people got special outfits for their waifus! I'm so happy you liked them <3
    [*] Our final girls are coming up in time for the 'one year since Crush Crush first launched' anniversary, based on when we first came out with our beta on Kongregate. That's Feb 9.
    [*] After we release the final girls we'll be launching a mobile version for iPhones/ iPads/ Androids. We need to do some heavy refactoring of the UI/layout for that since most people like to play in Portrait mode and our game is in landscape.
    [*] Voice Actresses!! We held an open casting call for many roles and will be finalizing the cast in February. It's going to be awesome to have all our girls speaking in the game (in English). The update for that will likely happen around Spring, but it'll be cool because those same actresses will be used in our Visual Novel since it'll feature many of the same characters.
    [*] After working on Crush Crush for over a year straight, Programmer Panda and I are finally taking a break this January to recharge our batteries... So I've set up a Steam account for my friend 'TroubleshooterPanda' who will be jumping in to chat/answer questions and handle support emails. Oji Panda should also be around to chime into discussions too :) Knowing me, I won't be completely relaxing on my vay-k though, as I have a ton of ideas I want to flesh out for our Crush Crush VN.
    [*] I mentioned it in my latest video but we are moving forward with plans to make a boy version of Crush Crush (as a separate game) which I'm calling Blush Blush. It's going to have the same humor, lighthearted story, and greatly improved art. I think you're gonna like it!
    [*] It's too early to share any details or concept art yet but we are making a Visual Novel with our girls, and going to try a Kickstarter in April. Reasons for that are the cost of original music, voice acting, background artwork and animation...it can be a hefty cost to an indie dev team ^_^;;
    [*] Lastly, the thing I'm probably the most excited for is a collaboration we've been working on with YandereDev; since Ayano has a cameo in our game we're delighted to say that some of our girls will be showing up in his game Yandere Simulator probably some time later this year. So on our side, we've been getting 3D models ready so they can show up as a special Crush Crush mode easter egg!!

[/list]
That's it for now! Thanks again for supporting us on Steam, Nutaku, and Patreon <3 We're all really looking forward to a great year of Sad Panda stuff!

notes.title: V.0.94 Holiday Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!  

This is a pretty huge update, and has been in the works for quite some time.  I'm excited to announce some of the major back-end changes and engine modifications that we have been working on :D  Oh, and there's a sale on for the holiday season, plus new holiday outfits that are available for a limited time!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Okay, we're excited about this!  The old game size was around 500-600MB depending on your platform.  The new game size (with no loss in quality) is under 200MB!  We were able to trim almost 2/3 of the build size off.  We also now dynamically load assets on boot, so you should find the game boots a lot quicker than before.
    [*] There is a new loading screen when the game first starts that identifies how many assets are being streamed from the disk.  The game takes longer to load the more girls you have unlocked, but should in all cases be faster than it used to be.  The game should also use far less RAM.
    [*] New holiday outfits and store support for bundles.
    [*] Some other new holiday features (snow particles, date images, etc).
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Ensure that Ayano will make comments about Karma and Sutra as well.
    [*] Make sure that the dark background added in some memory album scenes will not clip against some of the UI.
[/list]

As mentioned, the Holiday outfits are now available! You can purchase each individually in the Gifts tab, or get every girl's holiday outfit when you buy the '55 diamond' bundle or higher. Once you get a girl to Lover status the outfits will become wearable and will stay in your inventory even after we take down the holiday update/offer.

Thanks again for being so awesome! We hope you have a great holiday.

- Sad Pandas

notes.title: Hallowe'en Update - "Notice Me Senpai..."
notes.content:
Happy Hallowe'en, Crush Crushers! We've got a very special update for you with a surprise we've been cooking up for a while. We skipped the Beta build and went straight to release with this one. 

It is our pleasure (and horror) to introduce our first cameo character to Crush Crush:

Ayano "Yandere-Chan" Aishi - the lead character from the awesomely amazing game "Yandere Simulator"!!!     

Holy smokes peeps, this is a serious treat and honour for us. We've been in touch with the creator of Yandere Simulator (the fabulous “Yandere-Dev”) for a few months, and he's been incredibly generous and supportive of us adding Ayano to Crush Crush. And now she’s here!

Story time! As many of you know, Crush Crush has a bunch of fun tropes and references throughout the game, and we knew for a long time that we wanted to add a “Yandere” character. All of us here at Sad Panda are absolutely in love with Yandere Simulator, so we put on our courage-pants and sent Yandere-Dev an email requesting permission to use her. 

Well, he not only gave us permission, he’s been ridiculously helpful and trusting with us. 

If you haven’t heard of Yandere Simulator - welcome to the Internet! Gosh, all this “online” stuff must be so strange and new. Anyway - please go check out Yandere Simulator. And check out Yandere-Dev’s YouTube channel, so you’ll get all of the inside jokes. (Seriously, his voice is so soothing, it gives us the vapors).  

Ayano is a very different character from the other girls in Crush Crush. You might notice a few things… off about her. You might notice a few interesting Easter eggs too. Let us know what you think of her!

Be warned - Ayano has a very aggressive balance structure compared to the other girls, so don’t expect her to play by your rules, yo.

Also in this build are a few other changes and improvements:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Spookified date backgrounds added for this week! They'll be taken down after Hallowe'en :)
[*] Added a new girl! We hope you like her.
[*] Minor balance tweaks
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*] Fixed a bunch of typos.
	[*] Changed 'atone' to say 'sorry' to be easier on non-English speaking players
[*] Improved the autosave

So that’s the spooky-deets, my friends. Let us know how you’re doing, and have a Happy Hallowe'en!

Love you hard,
--
Sad Pandas

notes.title: Release 0.74 - Diamond Rings!
notes.content:
Hey everyone :)

If you've been following the forums you know we've been super busy with launches on new platforms.  We're very excited to keep the Steam version up to date, and today is the day we bring the latest features to the PC, Mac and Linux platforms.

We have some awesome new content in the works, and clearing this backlog of bugs has been instrumental to getting that new content ready to be deployed.  We have more than 4 ladies currently under development, and we're excited to get them in the game shortly!

One of the largest changes is to how we load certain assets on demand.  This allows us to use a bit less memory, and to swap assets easier using external files/remotely stored assets on the web/etc.  This will enable us to patch the game with different artwork if necessary.  You can read the full list of changes below :)

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] You can now resize the window when in windowed mode.  Some people have computers/monitors that don't support our 16:10 or 16:9 aspect ratio, which causes visual distortion.  Now you can resize to a resolution that makes sense to you when in windowed mode!
    [*] Lots of new dialogue once you reach lover level with the girls, including new gift, greet, talk and poke chit chat.
    [*] Do a better job at showing when outfits will become available (they'll become available at lover level).
    [*] You can now buy a diamond ring, which unlocks the wedding dress outfit.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Add in some dialogue for Nina that was missing.
    [*] Fixed a bunch of typos (achievement names, duplicate achievement names, Luna, Bonnibel and others).
    [*] Fixed a LONG standing bug where offline progress for jobs was calculated incorrectly.
    [*] Fix a glitch that was causing some introductions to not load correctly (only sometimes ... and I'm looking at you, Elle).
    [*] Fixed a bug that didn't allow the x64 multiplier to be purchased.
    [*] Fix a bug that can cause the 'likes you lot' pose to flash very quickly and then disappear when changing outfits.
    [*] Minor changes to Eva's dialogue.
    [*] Fix typos in the introduction text (non-ASCII single-quote was used).
    [*] Make sure to check if a session has timed out.  If it has, then log back in with a new session.  This will fix games not saving after the client has been open 24 hours or more on web.  Steam appears to be unaffected, but better safe than sorry.
    [*] Fixed a LONG standing issue where some girls would be cleared when loading from a cloud save.  Hopefully this fixes all of our save/load issues via cloud.
    [*] Fixed a bug that wouldn't enforce some of Eva's requirements.
    [*] Wizard job payouts would overflow the UI, so they've been scaled appropriately.
    [*] Fix number of iterations to level up the Restaurant job from Server to Barista.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Modified Luna's requirements a bit, since the new cost of gifts is very high.
    [*] Reduce the requirements on the hobby achievement, since it isn't possible to get lvl 80 hobbies yet.
    [*] Final items for Alpha and Bearverly will fill half of their heart affection.
    [*] Softened Cassie's early requirements, and made Iro a tiny bit more difficult.
[/list]

Thanks for playing Crush Crush!

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Release 0.48 - With Eva!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're proud to move our latest 0.48 release out of beta and into full release.  Hopefully you have as much fun playing as we have had developing!  There's a ton of new stuff in this release, alongside a new balance system for many of the girls, hobbies, jobs and prestige!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] A new girl is unlocked!
    [*] Rehauled the achievements page, reducing the amount of clutter and grouping things together.
    [*] Updated to the latest version of Unity
    [*] Started using asset bundling, which helps with file size and loading speed.  This is about 20% complete, there's still a long ways to go!
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fix Eva requirements to not require diamonds.
    [*] Fix low res image on Eva in the Steam branch.
    [*] Do not show progress bars on achievements that have already been earned.
    [*] Fix cost of plushy toy and tea set.
    [*] Fix a bug that causes hobbies that max out to cancel progress on an adjacent hobby.
    [*] Update to Unity 5.4.1 to fix particle effects not having a random seed.
    [*] Fix a (hilarious) bug that would cause the girl to wander of the screen if you poked her quickly.
    [*] Fix a bug that caused Linux to not load asset bundles properly (let me know if this works).
    [*] Fix a typo in Fumi's heart requirements.
    [*] Fix a typo in Pamu's dialog.
    [*] Hide outfits that are not yet available.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
    [*] OjiPanda basically changed everything, and there's a post about it here:  http://steamcommunity.com/app/459820/discussions/1/343785574518510700/
    [*] Slowed down the auto-heart generation by 3x.
    [*] Slightly reduced the chat heart strength.
    [*] Adjusted some of the jobs so that they take a bit longer to level up.
    [*] Changed the hobby times to be slightly longer (using an exponent of 1.425 instead of 1.4).
    [*] Skip reset no longer clears your pending prestige - so you could hit it as many times as you like, accumulating that prestige (assuming you have the diamonds to spend).  This should make skip reset a lot more powerful.
[/list]

Happy gaming!  Send us a message via Steam or to support@sadpandastudios.com if you run into any issues with the new build.

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.content:
Hey everyone.  This is Programmer Panda, and I'm excited to write a bit about the latest release.  We've been really busy this last month, so let's take a look at what happened!

[h1]Headliners[/h1]
[list]
    [*] A new character has been added to the game :D
    [*] Artist panda has created a [url=https://www.patreon.com/SadPandaStudios]Patreon[/url]!
    [*] Lots of prep work for future characters (they should come quicker now).
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Added a Luna Steam achievement!
    [*] Modify size of text in the speech and interaction boxes depending on the length of the text.
    [*] Added disclaimer to the Save Slot 2 section - make sure you read it! We'll be removing the second slot in our next update.
    [*] Added tons of new job promotion levels and achievements.
    [*] Luna! We haven't fully tested the balance of her yet, but she is meant to be harder/more end-game so let us know how it feels.
    [*] Wizard job is a real thing now! Bye bye no-clue placeholder :)
    [*] New gifts that unlock with Wizard job.
    [*] Added a fancy 'show/hide' button above all dialogue! This was asked for on the Forums, so thanks! It only force-shows itself when girl level-ups are ready.
    [*] Continued our work to reduce file size with lots of image optimizations.
    [*] The beginning of the 'dark portal' saga narrative...more to come in future girl updates!
    [*] Most (consumable) gift costs are the same however we've changed the optional diamond cost to all be 1 per item. This doesn't include outfits.
    [*] We knocked out the achievements page sorting for now since that's under construction - our next update should have a fancy improved layout!
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fix Luna's image to be high resolution in the Steam version.

notes.title: Update! 0.37
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've got a new update for ya :)

Our beta testers have been helping us find all sorts of bugs, user experience hiccups, typos, and other good stuff. We feel like it's in a good spot now to push an update to everyone! And we're really excited about this one because...

OUTFITS. 

Finally! The first wave of outfits are rolling out in this build - just in time for Summer, it's bathing suits ;D

You'll be able to buy them as gifts only at Lover Level, so that means they will be 'wearable' whenever you reach Lover status. The other cool thing is they're a one-time purchase so once you buy an outfit it'll stay in your inventory and activate at Lover level no matter how many times you prestige. *Note they won't persist across a hard reset*

[b]New Features:[/b]
 [*]Bundle OpenGL compatible GLSL shaders into the build to support OpenGL on the Windows version.
 [*]Game size is actually smaller by almost 300MB (and includes more content) because we are now encoding our textures as DXT5. Hopefully this transition goes smoothly for everyone, and also explains the larger 'update' size. All of those textures are effectively being replaced with this update.
 [*]Gift text size scales to fit in one line.
 [*]Keep track of how many dates you have been on in the dates overlay.
 [*]Our first attempt at clothing! You can buy bathing suits for the girls. Each girl makes enough diamonds to pick out one piece of clothing for them.
 [*]Save startup settings on prestige/reset to keep your resolution, monitor, etc. (Let me know if this works for you!)

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
 [*]Fixed some issue with Alpha and Bearverly sprites not updating correctly when they hit Lover status.
 [*]Fixed lots of typos reported by beta testers and other players. Thanks so much!
 [*]Fixed Steam job achievement.
 [*]Save played time across prestige/reset so that total time played can accumulate properly.
 [*]Special gift (Bearverly/Alpha) will stay as the last gift on page 3, and won't expand the gifts section into page 4 (which looked a bit weird).

[b]Balance Tweaks:[/b]
 [*]Extended hobbies to level 70.
 [*]Fixed Tea Set and Plushy Toy costs (they were swapped by accident).
 [*]Pamu now takes only a single diamond, and should only take it *once*. This means she will not take a diamond on successive playthroughs!

~~~~
Upcoming tasks:
More outfits! Gotta draw faster >.<
Endless Mode / Diamond ring
More dialogue & more ladies

notes.content:
Hey! Happy weekend!!

We've just pushed a build to everybody after doing lots of tests and making sure things ran well in the beta build. Beta testers, this will be old news to you, but here is what's new :

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

 [*]Fixed some art boo boos with Alpha
 [*]Fix image alignment issues with avatar on Skills, Hobbies and Jobs page.
 [*]Fix masking on the achievements page.
 [*]Fix aspect ratio of Bearverly memory album introduction art.
 [*]Fix 7 day cap so that it actually calculates 7 days correctly.
 [*]Fix potential crash that could occur when calculating offline progress.
 [*]Fix Alpha and Pamu images from not displaying correctly in the memory album in some instances.
 [*]Fix an out of bounds exception that could occur due to unsanitized save game data.
 [*]Support reading back older style strings and ints for 64-bit save game data.
 [*]Add extra debug support for tracking down hard to reproduce exceptions.
 [*]Only log exceptions the first time they are thrown.
